```{r}

## Trend equation using sum of squares
trend_1 <- lm(importexport ~ year,
            data = oil_dat)
summary(trend_1)
```

```{r}
# Extract variables
Ni <- oil_dat$spills
b1 <- oil_dat$importexport
b2 <- oil_dat$domestic

# Initial values (must give positive lambda)
alpha <- c(0.1, 0.1)

# Convergence settings
tol <- 1e-6
max_iter <- 50

for (iter in 1:max_iter) {
  
  # Compute lambda
  lambda <- alpha[1]*b1 + alpha[2]*b2
  
  # Avoid division issues
  if (any(lambda <= 0)) {
    stop("Non-positive lambda encountered. Adjust starting values.")
  }
  
  # ---------- SCORE VECTOR ----------
  U1 <- sum(b1 * (Ni / lambda - 1))
  U2 <- sum(b2 * (Ni / lambda - 1))
  U <- c(U1, U2)
  
  # ---------- HESSIAN MATRIX ----------
  H11 <- -sum(Ni * b1^2 / lambda^2)
  H12 <- -sum(Ni * b1 * b2 / lambda^2)
  H22 <- -sum(Ni * b2^2 / lambda^2)
  
  H <- matrix(c(H11, H12,
                H12, H22), nrow = 2)
  
  # ---------- UPDATE ----------
  step <- solve(H, U)      # H^{-1} U
  alpha_new <- alpha - step
  
  # ---------- CHECK CONVERGENCE ----------
  if (max(abs(alpha_new - alpha)) < tol) {
    cat("Converged in", iter, "iterations\n")
    break
  }
  
  alpha <- alpha_new
}

# Final estimates
alpha
```

```{r}
## Fisher Scoring Method
alpha <- c(0.1, 0.1)

for (iter in 1:max_iter) {
  
  lambda <- alpha[1]*b1 + alpha[2]*b2
  
  if (any(lambda <= 0)) stop("Non-positive lambda")
  
  # Score
  U1 <- sum(b1 * (Ni / lambda - 1))
  U2 <- sum(b2 * (Ni / lambda - 1))
  U <- c(U1, U2)
  
  # Fisher Information (EXPECTED Hessian)
  I11 <- sum(b1^2 / lambda)
  I12 <- sum(b1 * b2 / lambda)
  I22 <- sum(b2^2 / lambda)
  
  I <- matrix(c(I11, I12,
                I12, I22), nrow = 2)
  
  # Update
  step <- solve(I, U)
  alpha_new <- alpha + step
  
  if (max(abs(alpha_new - alpha)) < tol) {
    cat("Fisher scoring converged in", iter, "iterations\n")
    break
  }
  
  alpha <- alpha_new
}

alpha
```
